lines.say: On the fourteenth of July 1789, crowds stormed the Bastille.
The king was executed in 1793. And by 1804, Napoleon had crowned himself emperor.

beats.say: On the fourteenth of July 1789, crowds stormed the Bastille. The king was executed in 1793. And by 1804, Napoleon had crowned himself emperor.

lines.say: The state was in debt, and ordinary people carried the taxes.
Thinkers like Rousseau and Montesquieu had questioned the right of kings to rule.
